post.title: The biggest IPO ever paid bankers a tenth of the norm
post.ig:
The biggest IPO ever paid bankers a tenth of the normal fee.
SpaceX raised $75 billion (base deal; $85.7B with the overallotment) and paid about 0.7%.
Most mid-size IPOs pay banks exactly 7% (Jay Ritter data, 2001-2025).
SpaceX fees: about $500 million on the $75B base deal (June 2026).
Day one: $135 to $160.95, up 19%, about $14.4B left on the table (555.6M base shares).
Goldman's equity underwriting was $1.78B of $58.3B in 2025 revenue, about 3%.
Sources: Bloomberg, CNBC, Jay Ritter (Univ. of Florida), Goldman Sachs FY2025 10-K.
News and education, not financial advice.
